fields.statement: Change set 01M75S3 (inbox keeps a watchdog 'stalled run' item for an abandoned run): the core fix is that watchdog holds drop runs that are abandoned or whose change set is withdrawn/rejected (holds are recomputed every poll, so stale ones vanish on the next poll). The intent also suggests 'rhiza run abandon' should stop a live run cleanly instead of refusing with 'is running in another process' (today it takes kill-by-PID plus abandon racing the watchdog's resume). Should that second part be a leaf in this change set?
